user_story: As a staff member, I want to delete a pending booking so that cancelled or invalid bookings are removed.

positive.title: Successfully delete a pending booking
steps: Locate the pending booking in the list.
Click on the 'Delete' button next to the booking.
Confirm the deletion in the popup window.
positive.expected_result: The pending booking is removed from the list, and a success message is displayed.

negative.title: Attempt to delete an already deleted booking
steps: Locate the already deleted booking (should not be visible).
Try to click 'Delete' on this booking.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed stating that the booking cannot be found.

edge.title: Delete a booking during server maintenance
steps: Locate a pending booking in the list.
Click on the 'Delete' button next to the booking.
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the action cannot be performed due to server maintenance.
